description: This file defines the interface for rbusMessage API, including data structures, enums, callback types, and function prototypes for message handling in an rbus publish/subscribe system.

methods.name: rbusMessage_AddListener
methods.description: Adds a message listener for a specific topic expression.

methods.name: rbusMessage_RemoveListener
methods.description: Removes a message listener for a specific topic expression.

methods.name: rbusMessage_Send
methods.description: Sends a message with specified options.
